subject: Contractor conversion — comp plan & headcount sign-off for Alex Rivera
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contractor conversion — comp plan & headcount sign-off for Alex Rivera

Team,

Following up on our 1:1s — Alex Rivera (contractor on infra team, started 2025-11) has consistently exceeded expectations and the manager recommendation is to convert to FTE to retain his domain expertise in our K-V cache/serving work. Summary below and ask items.

Candidate snapshot:
- Role: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Inference Runtime)
- Current status: Contractor via Bridgepoint Talent, ~85/hr through Aug 2026
- Proposed start as FT: 2026-09-06 (flexible)

Proposed compensation (manager recommendation):
- Base: $170,000
- Bonus target: 10% (individual performance)
- Equity: 0.05% RSU grant, 4yr vest (1y cliff)
- Relocation: none (remote SF)

Rationale: Alex owns the KV-cache work that would be high-risk to backfill. Replacing/replicating knowledge would take ~3-4 months and a sizable ramp cost. He has been driving latency gains that map directly to QoS targets for a key customer.

Asks:
1) People Ops: confirm comp band placement and equity guidelines for this band, and prepare a formal offer memo (draft attached).
2) Finance: confirm headcount / budget impact and advise if base > midpoint requires exec exception.
3) Recruiting: confirm agency conversion fees or remaining obligations to Bridgepoint.

Attachments: draft offer memo + comp band matrix.

If we can get approval today / tomorrow, I can have the candidate finalize a start date and get to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Thanks Marcus — quick notes from recruiting and candidate check-ins:
- Alex is excited about the FTE path and prefers a September start; earliest available first week of Sept.
- He indicated a target base in the $160–175k band and would lean toward accepting if base + equity felt market-competitive.
- Bridgepoint conversion fee: per their master agreement, a one-time conversion payment equal to 10% of the first-year base (they invoiced this previously for another conversion). I've attached their fee schedule for reference.

I'll hold off on escalating verbally until comp / headcount are green.

– Mina

Also: please file a headcount ticket (HL-4512) with the staffing code and attach the expected cost over 12 months (include agency conversion fee). Hoping to resolve before end of week.

Thanks everyone — formal sign-off from People Ops on comp placement and next steps. Final approved package (People Ops + Finance alignment):

Offer summary (approved):
- Title: Senior Software Engineer
- Base salary: $172,000
- Bonus: 10% target
- Equity: 0.05% RSU grant (4-year vesting, 1y cliff)
- Start date: 2026-09-06 (flexible)
- Agency conversion fee: 10% of first-year base to Bridgepoint — recruiting to process invoice after acceptance.

Next steps:
1) Marcus / Mina: confirm start date with Alex and confirm whether to include sign-on (none approved).
2) Recruiting: prepare DocuSign package (I started a draft, link below) and initiation of background/ID check once Alex signs.
3) Marcus: please create the HL-4512 headcount ticket in the system and attach the signed offer after acceptance. Finance will then finalize budget coding.

Alex, welcome — we look forward to moving you onto the team. I'll loop legal for standard offer language and send the DocuSign package after you confirm the start date.

Best,
